invention.ref: Go (weiqi) traditionally dated to ancient China in the 2nd–1st millennium BCE
invention.ref_zh: 围棋传统上追溯至中国公元前二千纪至一千纪

popularization.ref: The Zuo Zhuan records an event in 548 BCE, providing early reliable written evidence
popularization.ref_zh: 《左传》记载公元前548年事，为目前较早可靠书证

locations.place_label_zh: 中国中原（早期围棋传统）

notes: 传说尧舜为教子而发明围棋，年代过于久远且无实证。学界普遍认为围棋起源于中国上古，但具体世纪难以敲定；目前较早的可靠文献是《左传》中涉及弈棋的记载。本条目以约公元前一千年为发明粗标，并以书证年作普及参照。
notes_en: Legends say Yao or Shun invented Go to teach their sons, but the remote dates lack evidence. Scholars generally place its origin in ancient China, though the century is unclear; the Zuo Zhuan contains an early reliable reference to play. This entry uses about 1000 BCE as a rough invention date and the written-evidence year as a popularization reference.
summary_zh: 围棋起源于中国上古，传说发明人不可考；约公元前一千年已可能存在，公元前548年《左传》提供较早书证。
summary_en: Go originated in ancient China; its legendary inventors cannot be verified. It may have existed around 1000 BCE; the Zuo Zhuan records an event in 548 BCE as early written evidence.
summary_ja: 囲碁は古代中国に起源があるが、伝説上の発明者については確かめられない。紀元前1000年頃には存在した可能性があり、『左伝』の紀元前548年の出来事に関する記述が初期の文献上の証拠となっている。
